articles.title: Cheating case accused dies after consuming poison while being taken into police custody
articles.description: a man wanted in a cheating case in yavatmal district died after consuming rat poison while police were picking him up from a petrol pump in nagpur on monday evening. the deceased has been identified as anand bhagat (30). he was wanted by the kalamb police in connection with a cheating case of around rs 5 lakh. according to police, bhagat was working as a manager at a petrol pump when he allegedly committed the fraud. the kalamb police had been searching for him after registering the case.
